title: Thick high-index film

series.label: tolerance × max(1, |Γ / Γ₀|), the accuracy asked for

worst_label: largest reported error / accuracy asked where it reports convergence (must stay below 1)
note: Eighteen guided poles sit on the real axis of the spectral integral; PyStratify takes their residues and charges the uncertainty of each pole's position to the error. Where it reports convergence the error stays within the tolerance, with all 18 poles found; where it cannot reach it (1e-08) it says so, not converged, rather than claiming the accuracy. The test asserts 1e-6 and checks total = escape + guided to the tolerance.
summary: the error reported against the accuracy asked for, 18 guided modes
